chicago-web-design.title: Web Design for Chicago Small Businesses — Doug Rosenberg
chicago-web-design.description: Custom websites for Chicago small businesses from a local .NET developer. In person at your shop or remote, projects from $750. Free discovery call.
chicago-web-design.headline: Websites for Chicago Small Businesses
chicago-web-design.answer: I'm Doug Rosenberg, a Chicago-based full-stack developer. I build custom websites for small businesses, and I'm glad to meet at your shop in Chicago or work remotely. Projects typically run $750–$3,000, and every engagement starts with a free discovery call.

schema.name: Doug Rosenberg — Web Design for Small Businesses

benefits.title: Designed Before It's Built
benefits.description: UI/UX design in Figma before a line of code, so you see and approve the site before it's built.

benefits.title: Fast and Accessible
benefits.description: Responsive builds with a WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility baseline, and performance checked with real tooling instead of eyeballed.

benefits.title: Someone You Can Reach
benefits.description: Direct access, no ticket queue. Ongoing support runs $300–$800 a month if you want it after launch.

benefits.title: In Person or Remote
benefits.description: Based in Chicago and happy to meet at your shop. Remote works just as well if that's easier.

work.title: Sonus Construction Group
work.description: An editorial-style site for a multi-family renovation contractor whose real audience is investors and developers vetting a partner.

work.title: Hardware Etc LLC
work.description: A bulk-materials supplier's site built to read as credible to spec-writers and to be fast for crews checking specs on-site.

faqs.question: Can you meet in person?
faqs.answer: Yes. I'm based in Chicago and happy to visit your shop. I also work remotely with clients anywhere, so location isn't a requirement.

faqs.question: What does a website cost?
faqs.answer: Custom web projects typically run $750–$3,000, scoped after a free discovery call so you know the price before any work starts.

faqs.question: What do you build it with?
faqs.answer: I build custom sites with Astro, Blazor, or Angular depending on what the project calls for, and I've also built on Squarespace when that was the right fit for the client.

faqs.question: Do you help after the site launches?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ongoing support covers updates, security patches, bug fixes, and small enhancements for $300–$800 a month, with direct access to me.

musician-websites.title: Websites for Musicians and Bands — Doug Rosenberg
musician-websites.description: Custom websites for working musicians and bands, built by a Chicago saxophonist and composer. Shows, music, and booking. Projects from $750.
musician-websites.headline: Websites for Musicians and Bands
musician-websites.answer: I'm a working Chicago saxophonist and composer who also builds websites, so I know what a band site has to do: show people where you're playing, let them hear you, and make booking easy. Custom projects typically run $750–$3,000, and every project starts with a free discovery call.

schema.name: Website design for musicians and bands

benefits.title: Built Around Your Own Art
benefits.description: For the band Guacamayo, every color, font pairing, and motif was sampled from the band's real flyer and logo instead of an invented identity.

benefits.title: Shows That Stay Current
benefits.description: Guacamayo's Shows section pulls its real gig dates from a calendar API at build time, with a graceful fallback if the fetch fails.

benefits.title: Not a Template
benefits.description: My own site, dougrosenberg.com, is a from-scratch custom build with a specific brand concept instead of generic musician-site defaults.

benefits.title: Made by a Working Musician
benefits.description: I'm a saxophonist and composer who plays in several working Chicago bands, so I build with real gigs and real audiences in mind.

work.title: Guacamayo
work.description: A currently-gigging Chicago funky Latin groove band's own site, built around the flyer art they already had.

work.title: dougrosenberg.com
work.description: My own musician and composer site, rebuilt from scratch in Astro and deployed to Cloudflare Workers.

faqs.question: Do you understand how working bands operate?
faqs.answer: Yes. I'm a saxophonist and composer and I play in several working Chicago bands, so I build with real gigs, press, and booking in mind.

faqs.question: What does a musician website cost?
faqs.answer: Custom web projects typically run $750–$3,000, scoped after a free discovery call so you know the price before any work starts.

faqs.question: Do I need to be in Chicago?
faqs.answer: No. I work remotely with clients anywhere, and I'm also happy to meet in person if you're in the Chicago area.

faqs.question: Do you help after the site launches?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ongoing support covers updates, security patches, bug fixes, and small enhancements for $300–$800 a month, with direct access to me.
